notes: Policy form: 無配当 指定通貨建積立利率変動型一時払終身保険, 指定通貨 米ドル or 円 (AUD not offered). Product page: sold face-to-face only (対面申込みでのみお取扱い), no health questions. Contract age 0 (15+ days old) to 90.

Rate-guarantee period confirmed on the product detail page: 積立利率保証期間 10年 (the applied rate is constant for 10 years, then the rate is reset). The 積立利率 is calculated on the 1st and 16th of each month; minimum guaranteed rate 0.01%. Once the insured is 101 or older, no further reset and the minimum rate applies. term_years in the CSV holds the guarantee period (10).

has_mva is true: 解約払戻金 = 積立金額 after 市場価格調整 and 解約控除 (detail page). The MVA formula (契約締結前交付書面 p15) and the current window's 平均指標金利 (USD 5.84%, JPY 3.48% for 2026-11-16〜30) are recorded in scripts/value/model_spec.json; no history of the reference rate is collected as a rate series.
The rate page lists the rate by 契約日 window (契約日 = day ORIX receives the premium) for contracts concluded in that window, e.g. 2026年11月16日～11月30日. effective_date is the first day of that window.
The rate page is shared by the whole 外貨建/一時払 range (/fx/whole-life/...), but only the Moonshot table (米ドル and 円, both 10年) is on it as of 2026-11-17.

The rate page shows only the current window and is overwritten. History comes from the 27 Wayback captures of the rate page saved under sources/orx/wayback/ (2024-11-19 to 2026-10-18; the collector reported 29 distinct 200-status CDX entries, and the 2025-11-21 capture answered 403 and was skipped): 23 distinct 契約日 windows from 2024-11-16 to 2026-11-16 (the current page). Several captures show the same window. Windows between captures are missing and are not interpolated. Rate-page captures before 2024-11-19 were not found.

Distributors: 14 institutions, each confirmed on the institution's own list of products handled on 2026-11-17 (snapshots under sources/orx/distributors/; full results in research_notes/gaps/orx-moonshot-distributors.json). ORIX Life's 取扱金融機関のご紹介 page (https://www.orixlife.co.jp/about/channel/list.html, 2026年1月1日現在) lists 64 institutions for ALL its products with no per-product marking, and the Moonshot pages and launch release name none, so each of the 64 was checked: 14 name Moonshot on their current single-premium whole life list, 京都銀行 lists it under 新規取扱停止保険商品 (new business stopped), and 49 do not list it. Caveats: 池田泉州銀行 shows the ORIX row as an image labelled 一時払終身保険 linking to ORIX's Moonshot page for banks, so the name is only in the link; 十六銀行 names it only in image alt text; 北都銀行 handles it only at its insurance-consultation counters and 百五銀行 says availability varies by branch. Six institutions (イオン, 関西みらい, 埼玉りそな, みずほ, みなと, りそな) refused the plain fetch and were read in a browser, so their saved copies are text extracts. 西日本シティ銀行 was recorded as listing Moonshot in an earlier research note but does not on the page saved 2026-11-17. Institutions not on ORIX's list were not checked. The product page says it is sold face-to-face only (対面申込みでのみ).

Average index rate (平均指標金利) page /fx/whole-life/market-interest-rate: the current window's values were read into scripts/value/model_spec.json (mva_reference_rate_pct); the page is not collected as a rate series, so there is no history.

Documents: the pamphlet and policy-conditions URLs are linked from the saved product pages. The teiketsumae.pdf URL came from the research brief and is not linked from any saved snapshot (the detail page links 契約締結前交付書面 to /importance/); it has not been fetched or confirmed.
Plan name shortened 2026-11-17: the one plan covers USD and JPY with a 10-year rate guarantee.

Launch date: 2024-11-18, from ORIX Life's news release of 2024-10-04 (「Moonshot（ムーンショット）」を発売; the release text as distributed on digitalpr.jp, a press-release wire; no copy was found on orixlife.co.jp). Retrieved 2026-11-17. Off-sale date: none found; the product is on sale on the live product page.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 16 November 2024 and has 23 half-month windows from archived copies; windows between copies are missing.
Rates are in USD and JPY only, with a 10-year guarantee and then a reset; the insurer overwrites its page each window.
It is sold face to face only, with no health questions.

Launched 18 November 2024, from the insurer's launch release as carried by a press-release wire; no copy was found on the insurer's own site. The market value adjustment formula and the current window's reference rate are in the value model; the reference rate's history is not collected.
Sold by 14 regional banks, each confirmed on the bank's own product list on 17 November 2026; the insurer publishes no list for this product. Kyoto Bank has stopped new sales.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:orx-moonshot; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.

distributors_source.basis: Each institution's own list of insurance products handled, read 2026-11-17, for the 64 institutions on ORIX Life's 取扱金融機関 page (2026年1月1日現在). The insurer publishes no per-product list.
